light.best.quote: in limited sun to bright shade locations

light.min.quote: Deep shade (Less than 2 hours to no direct sunlight)

light.directSun.quote: It will tolerate early morning sun or diffused sun.

temperature.minC.quote: The rattlesnake plant does not tolerate full sun, drafts, or sudden temperature changes.

temperature.minC.reason: 出典に最低温度の記載はないが、65°F（18℃）以上の安定した温度を必要とし、冷たいすきま風を避けるよう勧めるため13℃とした

temperature.idealC.quote: at room temperatures ranging from 65 to 75 degrees Fahrenheit

humidity.quote: To provide the required high humidity

watering.growing.quote: water regularly to keep soils moist (but not wet)

watering.winter.quote: Reduce watering and fertilization in winter when plant growth typically slows down.

tips.ja: 葉が黄色くなるのは、水の不足かやりすぎ。
tips.quote: Yellowing of the leaves can be a result of underwatering or overwatering.

tips.ja: 葉のふちや先が茶色く巻くのは湿度不足。
tips.quote: Browning or curling of the leaf edges and tips can result from low humidity.

tips.ja: 水やりで葉をぬらすと斑点が出やすい。
tips.quote: fungal leaf spots can occur from wetting the leaves when watering
